title: Ostomy Supply Program Supply-Burden Share for Customers on the Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
Supply burden adds a burden share to the share that multiplies the capped waiver base of an Ostomy Supply Program financial-hardship waiver when the customer also depends on continence supplies from Larkfield under the Urology and Continence Supply Program. The records read are the continence refill shipments sent to the customer in the last 12 months (ship date fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day the waiver is worked out).

| Continence refills shipped to the customer in the last 12 months | Share added |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | 5% (the higher burden share) |
| 2 or 3 | 2% (the lower burden share) |
| Fewer than 2 | Nothing |

The burden share is added to the share that multiplies the capped waiver base.

**Basis questions (hypothetical).** One continence refill in the last 12 months adds nothing; two add 2%; three add 2%; four add 5%.
